messages.subject: Summary statistics from GWAS meta-analysis for multivariate GWAS
parts:
Hi,

I would appreciate if you could help me confirm whether I am taking a right approach for the following issue,

I am planning to conduct multivariate GWAS using summary statistics from meta analysis from GWAS data from different cohorts.

In that case, I wanted to confirm whether the sample size (N) is the sum of sample sizes from the different cohorts. Similarly, the sample prevalence is calculated considering number of cases and controls in all cohorts. Is that correct?

best regards
